installed.meaning: Installed snapshot per appliance.xenia.v1; the request body contains exactly this or discovered.

discovered.meaning: Discovered snapshot per appliance.xenia.v1; the request body contains exactly this or installed.

changed.meaning: Whether the snapshot differs from the prior value; the register is written even when false.

final.meaning: Entry, selected snapshot and convergence observations.

observed.meaning: Prior outcome if the outcome form check fails.

message.meaning: Refusal message; can include runtime error detail.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The handler places refusal tokens and open error detail in message, not firstMissingSignal. The enum lists fixed signal literals supplied by this handler.
